$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH. Canonical agent-integration manifest for the Microelectronic Block Generator. Edited by hand; consumed by scripts/sync_agent_tools.py to generate the OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex adapters. JSON is used because it is the only zero-dependency format available on every interpreter in this repository (the root .venv lacks PyYAML, the chipathon .venv lacks tomllib).

analyze_spice.summary: Parse SPICE subcircuits, enumerate devices, nets and terminals, and trace connectivity.

audit_ai_experiment.summary: Audit an AI experiment record for reproducibility, bounded refinement and evidence.

author_extension.summary: Create or review agent skills, commands and tools using the project authoring standard.

compare_layout_results.summary: Compare a new layout run against a preserved baseline without overwriting it.

debug_placement.summary: Inspect placement: matching, symmetry, overlap, pin access, reserved zones, congestion.

debug_routing.summary: Trace nets, inspect vias and metal usage, and detect shorts, opens and route conflicts.

generate_views.summary: Emit LEF, Liberty, Verilog and a views manifest alongside the GDS for every module.

inspect_generated_designs.summary: Read previous results in AI-Generated-Design-Result as evidence and regression baselines.

inspect_repository.summary: Map the repository, trace the active execution path, and separate active from legacy code.

install_agents.summary: Register the agent integrations for OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex — repo-scoped, or user-wide so /mbg-* works from any directory.

integrate_modules.summary: Collect generated modules into a LibreLane macro integration with info.yaml and lvs_config.json.

run_drc.summary: Run Magic DRC on a GDS and interpret the error tiles.

run_lvs.summary: Run netgen LVS against the source netlist and interpret topology, property and pin results.

run_pex.summary: Run parasitic extraction and produce a post-layout netlist.

run_simulation.summary: Run ngspice on a netlist and parse the raw output into usable data.

setup_environment.summary: Install or repair the whole environment with ./install.sh — Python, GF180MCU PDK, Magic/netgen/KLayout, and the $MBG_HOME (~/.mbg) shell integration and mbg launchers — and report the toolchain and PDK.

simulate_analyses.summary: Operating point, DC, AC, transient, Monte Carlo and FFT via mbg.analysis.Testbench.

spice_to_gds.summary: Generate a DRC-clean GDSII layout from a SPICE subcircuit via gLayout.

sync_agent_metadata.summary: Rescan the repository, refresh the project index and regenerate all platform adapters.

verify_connectivity.summary: Compare physical connectivity against the SPICE netlist before external signoff.

run_design_flow.summary: Run the two-loop design flow: pre-layout optimisation, then PEX-aware post-layout optimisation against target specifications.

evaluate_specifications.summary: Evaluate measured metrics against target specs and quantify pre-layout vs post-layout degradation.

simulate_extracted_netlist.summary: Simulate the PEX-extracted netlist — a stage separate from PEX extraction.

run_full_auto.summary: FULL AUTOMATE: one design request driven through specification, both optimisation loops, multi-agent review and the tapeout-ready sign-off gate.

review_design_stage.summary: Run the independent Devil and Angel reviewers over one design stage and return structured findings.

synthesize_reviews.summary: Combine reviewer output with measured evidence into a decision; evidence and hard gates take precedence.

signoff_gate.summary: Evaluate the explicit tapeout-ready gate; unevaluated conditions report NOT RUN and never count as passed.

work_economically.summary: Work in this repository without exhausting the context window: resolve the repo from $MBG_ROOT, index before reading, never poll git state, and climb the verification ladder cheapest-first.

mbg-full-automate.summary: Full automatic analog IC design flow, specification to tapeout-ready layout.

mbg-partial-automate.summary: Semi-automatic analog IC design flow with user confirmation at each stage.

mbg-review-ai-experiment.summary: Review an AI experiment record for reproducibility and evidence.

mbg-review-extension.summary: Review an agent extension against the project authoring and safety rules.

mbg-new-skill.summary: Scaffold a new canonical skill under .ai/skills and resync all platforms.

mbg-new-command.summary: Scaffold a new canonical workflow under .ai/workflows and resync all platforms.

mbg-new-tool.summary: Create a safe OpenCode custom tool using the project authoring standard.
